title: Flávio Bolsonaro lands in Miami after Brazil election loss
summary_full: Far-right senator and family land in US after crossing from Brazil into Argentina and then flying via EcuadorA jet carrying the Brazilian far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro has landed in Miami, Florida, where the losing candidate in Sunday’s presidential election runoff left the airport under police escort without speaking to the press.The Gulfstream IV, registered as LV-JQW, left Guayaquil in Ecuador earlier in the day.
